summary.en: Servier's foundation-governed R&D focuses on rare cancers and neurology, combining partnerships with acquisitions. Darovasertib and the acquired ADC portfolio are prominent after sevasemten development was discontinued.
summary.zh: Servier由基金会治理的研发聚焦罕见癌症和神经科学，将合作与收购相结合。在sevasemten开发终止后，darovasertib和收购的ADC组合尤为突出。

ind.en: Uveal melanoma: adjuvant; also metastatic and neoadjuvant development
ind.zh: 葡萄膜黑色素瘤：辅助治疗；另有转移性和新辅助治疗开发

ind.en: Aggressive adenoid cystic carcinoma; also other solid tumors
ind.zh: 侵袭性腺样囊性癌；另有其他实体瘤
复发/难治性急性白血病
KCNT1相关发育性和癫痫性脑病

watch.en: The pivotal Phase 2 EMBLEM-1 cohort for Emi-Le began dosing in October 2026.
watch.zh: Emi-Le的关键性II期EMBLEM-1队列于2026年10月开始给药。

watch.en: Sevasemten missed GRAND CANYON's primary and secondary endpoints; Servier discontinued BMD and DMD studies.
watch.zh: Sevasemten未达到GRAND CANYON的主要和次要终点；Servier终止了BMD和DMD研究。

watch.en: The Day One acquisition added tovorafenib, Emi-Le and DAY301 for approximately USD 2.5 billion equity value.
watch.zh: 收购Day One新增tovorafenib、Emi-Le和DAY301，股权价值约25亿美元。

watch.en: Oncology generated 32.2% of 2024/25 revenue, driven by U.S. Voranigo growth.
watch.zh: 肿瘤贡献了2024/25年度收入的32.2%，由美国Voranigo增长驱动。

gaps: The most recent verified financial release covers 2024/25 and was published January 27, 2026, before June 2026; a later interim/annual release was not verified.
The pipeline publishes early/late development totals, not a verified complete Phase 1/2/3/registration split; counts is null.

S243249 and S230815 are Phase 1/2 trials, represented conservatively as phase 1 rather than assuming that Phase 2 portions have started. Regulator records corroborate their trial titles; dedicated company trial pages returned 403.
S243249 and S230815 origins were not verified; origin is null. ASO S230815 maps to other in the allowed modality vocabulary.

Darovasertib is co-developed with IDEAYA; Servier holds regulatory/commercial rights outside the U.S. A rolling U.S. NDA submission had started, but no completed Servier-territory filing was verified.
The April 23 Day One acquisition source predates June 2026; it establishes acquired provenance for Emi-Le and DAY301.
Next milestone dates were not verified for selected assets; next is null. Unverified codes are null.

The October pipeline still lists sevasemten; the November 13 discontinuation update supersedes it. Approved ivosidenib, vorasidenib and tovorafenib without a verified major new filed indication are excluded.
